decision.explanation: All four candidates are supported by direct textual references in the provided documents. Document D1S4 explicitly confirms that Luis Santa María Calderón held the position of Member of the Chamber of Deputies of Peru. Document D2S8 states that he previously served as a member of Congress and mayor of a major Peruvian city. Document D2S1 announces his current role as Administrator. These are distinct and non-conflicting claims about the same individual, and none of the sources contradict each other.
